cli_finding.verdict: obsidian-cli-inspector's Hash is a size_hex:mtime_epoch pseudo-hash, not a content digest; it cannot serve as the vault-side sha256 oracle, so sha256sum remains the verifier of record

method.independence: own fixtures under tests/vault/fixture-*-<seat>/ + own ledger tests/vault/vrun-<seat>-ledger.tsv; no other seat's fixtures or ledgers consumed
method.vault_access: read-only: sha256sum/find/stat/git-rev-parse only; no writes, no notes created, no git index-refresh commands run against the vault
method.gui_policy: the GUI launcher /usr/bin/obsidian is never executed; obsidian-cli-inspector probed with timeout 5 (--version/--help only); S4 uses an own config/db under the scratch dir
method.tool_selection: first existing of tools/souji-vault-verify.sh, tools/obsidian-vault-verify.sh, tools/vault-verify.sh, tools/souji-verify.sh (or --tool)
method.twin: check IDs V1..V13b/A0..A6/C1..C11 mirror tests/vault/runner-35.sh so vrun-35.json and vrun-36.json can be diffed; S36 additions: --wait for the r4 tool, souji-vault-verify-first tool selection, per-impl matrix (impl-rows below), S6 index-scale and S7 live-app info rows
